questions: Should the predefined sentences SENTENCES be used only to fit the CountVectorizer's vocabulary, or should the input string be vectorized in the context of the combined vocabulary of SENTENCES plus the input string itself?
Is the input string preprocessed (e.g., lowercasing, punctuation removal) before vectorization, and if so, how exactly?
What tokenization pattern should be used (e.g., default CountVectorizer token_pattern=r'(?u)\b\w\w+\b')?
Should the function always return a 1D array, or could it be 2D depending on the CountVectorizer output?
If the input string contains words not in SENTENCES, should they be included in the vocabulary?
Should the function handle stop words removal or any other CountVectorizer parameters beyond default?
Is the order of words in the vocabulary (and thus array indices) defined, e.g., alphabetical or by first appearance?
Should the function raise an error for non-string input, or attempt to convert?
